title: Production and characterization of novel antioxidant peptides from mulberry leaf ferment using B. subtilis H4 and B. amyloliquefaciens LFB112.
authors: Abbas, Zaheer; Zhang, Jing; Tong, Yucui; Ahmad, Baseer; Wang, Junyong; Zhang, Haosen; Li, Zhenzhen; Wei, Xubiao; Zhang, Rijun; Si, Dayong
one_liner_zh: 该研究从桑叶发酵物中分离抗氧化肽并验证其Keap1结合活性，对象为肽-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The objective of this study was to isolate and characterize antioxidant peptides from mulberry leaves fermented with Bacillus subtilis H4 and Bacillus amyloliquefaciens LFB112. The results indicated that fraction F4 (<1 kDa) exhibited superior DPPH activity compared to the F1 (>10 kDa), F2 (3-10 kDa), and F3 (1-3 kDa) fractions, and cytoprotective effect against lipopolysaccharides (LPS)-induced oxidative stress in RAW264.7 cells. Three novel peptides, FRFDP, RFGG, and GPPLAFGGGP, were identified in the F4 fraction of the mulberry leaf ferment, and docking results showed that these peptides could form stable carbon (covalent) and hydrogen bonds to the active sites of Keap1, thus regulating the Keap1-Nrf2 pathway by blocking the Nrf2 binding sites on Keap1. These peptides significantly upregulated the mRNA expression of Nrf2, HO-1, and NQO1, providing indirect evidence of their potential to enhance cellular antioxidant defense via the possible activation of Keap1-Nrf2 pathway. Furthermore, these peptides showed good DPPH and ABTS scavenging activities, indicating their potential as antioxidant peptides. This study offers valuable insights into the integration of these novel peptides in developing mulberry leaf ferment as a functional food and their potential use as a feed additive.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在从枯草芽孢杆菌H4和解淀粉芽孢杆菌LFB112发酵的桑叶中分离并表征抗氧化肽。结果表明，与F1（>10 kDa）、F2（3-10 kDa）和F3（1-3 kDa）组分相比，F4组分（<1 kDa）表现出更优的DPPH活性，并对脂多糖（LPS）诱导的RAW264.7细胞氧化应激具有细胞保护作用。在桑叶发酵液的F4组分中鉴定出三种新型肽，即FRFDP、RFGG和GPPLAFGGGP，对接结果显示这些肽能与Keap1的活性位点形成稳定的碳（共价）键和氢键，从而通过阻断Keap1上的Nrf2结合位点来调控Keap1-Nrf2通路。这些肽显著上调了Nrf2、HO-1和NQO1的mRNA表达，为其通过可能激活Keap1-Nrf2通路增强细胞抗氧化防御的潜力提供了间接证据。此外，这些肽表现出良好的DPPH和ABTS清除活性，表明其作为抗氧化肽的潜力。本研究为将这些新型肽整合到开发桑叶发酵物作为功能性食品及其作为饲料添加剂的潜在用途提供了有价值的见解。
